title: Asst Manager / Manager - Philanthropic Partnerships (Grants & Growth)
description:
Category: NGO/Social Services

Location:

About the Role:

Bhumi is at a pivotal stage of growth. We are looking for a seasoned Consultant for Philanthropic Partnerships to raise funds from institutional and family foundations.

Your primary goal is to build a bridge between Bhumi and foundations. This isn't just about making introductions; it’s about refining our strategy, professionalising our systems, and securing the kind of long-term, unrestricted funding that allows an organization to scale its impact truly.

Roles and Responsibilities:

• Strategic prospecting: Deliver a comprehensive Strategic Prospect Map for FY26 and successfully secure introductory calls with high-potential partners.

• Drive new partnerships: Connect with foundations and family offices, focusing on securing multi-year commitments or corpus funding.

• Standardise high-quality outreach: Develop clear, high-conversion templates and communication materials that reflect Bhumi ’s impact and resonate with sophisticated funders.

• Lead high-impact grant development: Spearhead the writing and submission of major, strategically aligned proposals that meet high internal quality standards

• Build a long-term roadmap: Design a clear "prospect-to-partner" journey that ensures a smooth transition from the first conversation to a signed, long-term agreement.

Other Responsibilities:

• Streamline the growth system: Review and improve existing internal processes-from how we use our CRM to how we manage our pipeline-to ensure no lead or relationship falls through the cracks.

• Strategic mentorship: Work closely with our internal team to sharpen their fundraising skills, helping them understand donor psychology and how to navigate complex negotiations.

Educational Qualification/Experience:

• Educational Degree : Anything

• Relevant Experience(in years) : 5-8 years

Knowledge & Skill sets required:

• At least 5-8 years of experience in high-level fundraising, with a history of securing multi-year grants from major foundations, particularly for Education

• The ability to translate complex social impact data into a compelling, professional investment case for sophisticated donors.

• Basic understanding of CRM management and pipeline tracking; you believe that data-driven fundraising is the most effective fundraising.

• Experience in coaching or leading teams, with the patience and clarity to transfer your skills to our internal staff.

Others:

• Scope : Full Time

• Age Criteria : 35-40

• Reporting to : Executive Director

• Salary Range: 7-10 LPA based on the candidate's profile including performance-based incentives

• Expected Start Date: Immediate

• Location: Anywhere

description:
About Us
Sophos is a cybersecurity leader defending 600,000 organizations globally with an AI-driven platform and expert-led services. Sophos meets organizations wherever they are in their security maturity and grows with them to defeat cyberattacks. Its solutions combine machine learning, automation, and real-time threat intelligence with frontline human expertise from Sophos X-Ops to deliver advanced, 24/7 threat monitoring, detection, and response.
 
Sophos offers industry-leading managed detection and response (MDR) alongside a comprehensive portfolio of cybersecurity technologies - including endpoint, network, email, and cloud security, extended detection and response (XDR), identity threat detection and response (ITDR), and next-gen SIEM. Together with expert advisory services, these capabilities help organizations proactively reduce risk and respond faster, with the visibility and scalability needed to stay ahead of evolving threats.

title: Principal Product Designer - Hospitality
description:
This hybrid role requires working in the office two days per week.

With millions of diners, 70,000+ restaurant partners and 25+ years of experience, OpenTable, part of Booking Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: BKNG), is an industry leader with a passion for helping restaurants thrive. Our world-class technology empowers restaurants to focus on what matters most - their team, their guests, and their bottom line - while enabling diners to discover and book the perfect restaurant for every occasion. 

Every employee at OpenTable has a tangible impact on what we do and how we do it. You’ll also be part of a global team and its portfolio of metasearch brands. Hospitality is all about taking care of others, and it defines our culture.

About the job

OpenTable helps restaurants turn guests into regulars and the Hospitality team is where that promise is designed. As Principal Product Designer, you will own the design vision for how restaurants communicate with their guests, using AI to speed the process without sacrificing a personal touch. You will set design strategy across the Hospitality portfolio, partnering with product, engineering, data, and research leaders to shape what we build and why. Your work will directly influence whether restaurants trust the guest information we give them and act on it to deliver better service and bring more guests back.

This posting is for an existing vacancy and will report directly to the Design Director of Hospitality.

Responsibilities

• Lead the design vision and strategy for guest communication, helping restaurants send timely, personalized messages that keep their guests engaged.

• Shape multi-year product direction across the Hospitality portfolio with cross-functional partners, translating business goals into a coherent user experience.

• Turn complex guest data into interfaces restaurants trust and use, from recognizing a returning guest to acting on that context during service.

• Deliver high-quality end-to-end design, framing the problem through polished, accessible interfaces and raising the bar for craft across the team.

• Build alignment on design decisions with senior stakeholders through clear storytelling, prototypes, and evidence from research.

• Mentor designers and strengthen shared design practices, patterns, and critique across the organization.

**When applying, please include your  online portfolio link and password in the application. We are reviewing portfolios thoroughly as part of the selection process and we appreciate the opportunity to learn more about you and your work. Thank you!

Minimum Qualifications

• 7+ years of professional product design experience, including leading design for complex, large-scale products.

• A portfolio demonstrating design strategy, interaction design, and exceptional visual craft across web and mobile.

• Expertise in Figma and modern prototyping tools.

• Proven ability to set and drive design vision with cross-functional partners in product, engineering, and research.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of articulating and defending design decisions to senior audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience incorporating AI tools into design workflows to improve speed and quality of outcomes.

• Experience designing for two-sided marketplaces or for both consumer and business users.

• Familiarity with designing for data quality, identity, or personalization systems.

• Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth

• Paid parental leave

• Paid volunteer time

title: YouTube Long-Form Editor
description:
Job Purpose
The YouTube Long-Form Editor owns the end-to-end edit pipeline across two channels in The Scalable Company 's orbit:

• Roland Frasier (partner): 3-4 long-form videos per month, totaling 3-6 hours of finished content.

• Ryan Deiss (CEO): 3-4 long-form videos per month, totaling 3-6 hours of finished content.

You're the person who turns hours of unstructured camera files into the kind of long-form videos that actually get watched: tight pacing, clean audio, deliberate B-roll, and structure that earns the viewer's attention all the way through.
Important context: Until now, both channels have been edited by an outside agency. You are not stepping into a polished in-house pipeline. You are stepping in to build it. The templates, the asset libraries, the project organization, the revision workflow, the feedback loops - none of that exists in-house yet. You'll be designing and refining those foundational systems alongside the Senior Content Strategist as you do the work.
This is a, strategic, hands-on craft role, and a system-building role. Success looks like videos that publish on time, hold retention above benchmark, require minimal revision rounds - and a documented edit workflow that any future team member could plug into.
Success in this role is measured by on-time publish cadence across both channels, average view duration, revision efficiency, the quality bar of every finished cut, and the durability of the workflows you build.
Critical Accountabilities

• Own the long-form edit pipeline across both channels - taking raw footage to publish-ready cut for 3-4 Roland Frasier videos per month (~30 min finished length each) and 3-4 Ryan Deiss videos per month (~30 min finished length each).

• Build the foundational in-house edit workflow from scratch - templates, asset organization, revision loops, feedback systems, project archiving. By month 3, the workflow should be documented well enough that a future team member could plug into it without a 4-week ramp.

• Build and refine each channel's edit signature - pacing, B-roll usage, music/SFX choices, lower-thirds, transitions. Roland and Ryan have distinct voices and audiences. Your job is to make each channel feel unmistakably like itself.

• Manage project files, asset libraries, and version control in Frame.io and Premiere - projects organized, archives clean, revisions clearly tracked so nothing gets lost or duplicated.

• Direct your own creative decisions on cuts, pacing, and structure - bring the Senior Content Strategist a draft that's ready to evaluate, not a rough assembly that requires rebuilding.

• Iterate fast on revision feedback - target is ≤2 revision rounds per video. You take notes well, ask the right clarifying questions before opening the project, and ship the next version quickly.

• Watch the analytics on your own work - pull YouTube Studio retention curves on every published video and adjust future edits based on where audiences are dropping off.

What Success Looks Like

• Videos ship on cadence across both channels, week after week, without the Senior Content Strategist having to ask "where are we" the day before publish.

• Both Roland's and Ryan's channels have recognizable, distinct edit signatures - visibly improving quarter over quarter.

• The in-house edit workflow is documented, organized, and durable - onboarding a junior editor or motion designer down the road would take no more than 2 weeks.

• Revision rounds stay at 2 or fewer per video because your first draft already accounts for each channel's voice and the strategist's priorities.

• Project files are clean, archived, and findable months later - no panic searches for a missing B-roll clip.

• You proactively flag what's not working in the raw footage before spending hours editing around a problem.

• A consistent publication record in leading venues within your domain, with recent results published in the past year.

• Deep, hands-on experience with computational research methods: simulation, numerical analysis, algorithmic implementation, and/or high-performance computing environments.

As Site Services Manager for the UK, Ireland & Hubs, you’ll lead the strategy and day-to-day performance of our facilities and maintenance operations across our Distribution Centres, offices and regional delivery hubs. You’ll be responsible for keeping our sites safe, compliant and operational 24/7, while driving improvements across asset performance, maintenance, automation and facilities infrastructure. Working closely with Operations, Finance and EU Engineering teams, you’ll also lead major engineering projects, CapEx initiatives and long-term plans to support HelloFresh’s continued growth.

What You Will Be Doing:

● Lead multi-site facilities and maintenance operations across the UK and Ireland, covering asset maintenance, cleaning, security and site infrastructure

● Own the performance and availability of critical equipment, ensuring high levels of uptime, compliance and operational reliability across a 24/7 business

● Manage facilities and maintenance suppliers and contractors, including contract performance, tenders, commercial negotiations and invoice approval

● Lead facilities and engineering projects from end to end, including equipment upgrades, system modifications, new technology rollouts and CapEx initiatives

● Work closely with Operations, Finance and EU Engineering teams to plan future equipment replacements, upgrades and system improvements, using data and ROI analysis to support investment decisions

● Develop and track key maintenance KPIs, including equipment uptime, efficiency, maintenance costs and continuous improvement activity

● Oversee the installation and commissioning of new equipment, ensuring safe integration into existing systems and compliance with relevant standards and regulations

● Lead, develop and support the engineering team, including maintenance planning, training and capability development, while role-modelling the HelloFresh DNA and a strong culture of safety, compliance and continuous improvement

Who You Are:

● An experienced engineering or facilities leader, with a background managing teams of engineers/technicians and large-scale automation or maintenance projects

● Qualified to NVQ/HNC Engineering level or equivalent, with Management Level 3 qualification; a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering or a related field would be desirable

● Experienced in project management, with a track record of successfully delivering engineering, automation, equipment or CapEx projects; experience with Dematic automation systems is highly desirable

● Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to use data to make decisions, identify opportunities and drive continuous improvement

● Confident working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, with strong communication, organisation and time-management skills

● Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and able to balance competing priorities while maintaining high standards of safety, compliance, performance and operational delivery

What you will get in return:

● 70% off HelloFresh or Green Chef boxes
● Company pension scheme
● Gym membership
● Bupa private medical insurance (including dental & family cover options)
● Mental health first aiders and an employee assistance programme
● Eye care scheme
● Cycle to work scheme
● Group Life Assurance

Next steps : Your application will be reviewed and if successful, a member of the Talent Acquisition Team will be in touch within 2 weeks.

You are required to cooperate with HelloFresh in all health and safety matters. You are responsible for ensuring you take reasonable care of your own health, and safety as well as others who may be affected by the work activities you undertake. You must report incidents immediately and actively raise health and safety-related concerns to your Line Manager.

If you are currently a HelloFresh employee, please make sure you have discussed your application with your Line Manager.

title: Head of Technical Accounting & Reporting
description:
TL;DR: We're looking for someone to own technical accounting and reporting at Lovable as we build toward being a generational company. You'll be the person who works out the right US GAAP answer on the questions that matter, writes it down so an auditor can rely on it, and turns it into reporting that would stand up to scrutiny. You'll report to our Group Financial Controller. This is a builder's role: there is a lot to set up, and you'll do much of it yourself.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

The role

Lovable's business model raises real accounting questions. We sell subscriptions and usage-based credits to millions of self-serve users and to enterprise customers, through our own billing, app stores and payment processors. We buy a lot of AI compute. We have US, Swedish and UK entities and we report under US GAAP. Most of these questions have been answered at a point in time. They need proper answers, written down, and kept current as the business changes, without slowing the business down to get there.

You'll own that. Stock-based compensation, leases, LLM commitments, consolidation and foreign currency, M&A accounting and whatever comes next as we launch new products and features. You'll own the accounting policies, the position papers and the relationship with our auditors on technical matters.

You'll also own external reporting: building the financial statements, disclosures and reporting calendar we'll need as a public company, well before we need them, and doing it in a way that is as automated as possible. We expect you to leverage AI to draft disclosures, tie out numbers and flag changes. You'll decide where that's safe and where a person has to own the judgment.

You'll report to our Group Financial Controller, and work closely with our head of Revenue Accounting and our Chief Accounting Officer, on the significant judgments.

What we’re looking for

Must have

- Deep US GAAP expertise, with ASC 842 for leases and ASC 718 for Stock Based Compensation as a strength. You've written position papers that auditors have accepted on complex matters.

- Big 4 background, ideally including exposure to national office, accounting advisory or SEC reporting work, followed by in-house experience at a technology company.

- Has built or materially upgraded an external reporting process: financial statements, disclosures, tie-outs and the calendar behind them.

- Can explain a complex accounting conclusion to an engineer or a product manager in plain English, and change their mind when the facts warrant it.

- Comfortable operating in ambiguity and building an AI first function from the ground up.

- Pragmatic about applying accounting guidance to minimize operational overhead.

Nice to have

- Has operated in a hypergrowth environment, including ideally through an IPO or the first

title: Senior Product Owner
description:
We are hiring a Senior Product Owner who gets energy from structure, flow and a perfectly organised backlog. Someone who wants to make sure great ideas actually reach healthcare professionals through product developments.

Our Mission
Attendi has already built a strong user base through speech-to-text integrations with electronic health record (EHR) vendors, used by over 300 care organisations in elderly and disability care. With the Attendi App, we are building a one-stop solution for AI-driven administration in healthcare: structured documentation, conversation summaries, voice-driven workflows and AI assistance, anytime, anywhere.
Our product and development team is growing fast. Our Product Lead, a former nurse, owns the what and the why: our users, the roadmap and experiments. To keep up with the pace, we’re looking for someone who owns the how and the when: turning that roadmap into well-structured, realistic and predictable delivery, together with our development team leads.

Your Role
As Senior Product Owner at Attendi, you will:

• Translate roadmap items, experiments and MVPs into epics and user stories, with clear acceptance criteria and non-functional requirements (performance, security, privacy, platforms).

• Own the development backlog in Jira: clear, up to date and one to two sprints ahead with work that’s ready to build.

• Set up and guard our Definition of Ready and Definition of Done.

• Prepare and lead refinement and sprint planning with our dev team leads.

• Propose 6-week cycle goals and sprint goals, based on capacity, dependencies, risk and effort.

• Propose the balance between features, bugs, tech debt and maintenance.

• Be the first point of contact for developers on tickets, and handle small scope questions yourself.

• Spot blockers, risks and delays early and solve them with the dev leads.

• Help turn uncertain AI work into small, measurable experiments.

• Accept delivered work, prepare phased rollouts and pilots, and write release notes for sales, implementation and support.

• Make sure our requirements are traceable from requirement to story, test and release, as required for our medical device (MDR) certification.

• Align technically with EHR vendors and partners on integrations, APIs and releases.

• Make progress visible with Jira dashboards and delivery metrics.

You might be a good fit if you hit most or all of the following:

• 5+ years of experience as a Product Owner in software product teams.

• Strong command of Scrum and agile delivery, and you know when to adapt it.

• Technical enough to discuss solutions with engineers, understand trade-offs and help make realistic estimates.

• You keep the customer at the centre of the backlog, and link technical work to what users need.

• You love structure: a clear backlog, a steady rhythm and predictable delivery give you energy.

• Low ego, high ownership. You’re a builder who wants to ship a bit better every week.

• You move fast, but carefully. You understand that in healthcare, getting it right matters.

• Experience with Jira.

• Fluent in English.

Strong candidates may also

• Have a background in software engineering.

• Have experience with AI products, and with an AI-native way of working.

• Have worked in healthcare or another regulated environment, for example with MDR, IEC 62304 or similar.

• Have worked with integrations and external partners.

• Speak Dutch.

What we offer

• Ideally 32 hours per week.

• €6,000 - €7,000 per month (based on 40h)

• Hybrid working: roughly half the week at home, half at our Amsterdam office.

• Travel and lunch allowance.

• Home office budget.

• Lease bike.

• Training budget of €1,500 per year.

• Company MacBook.

• ClassPass membership.

• Pension contribution of 10% and roughly 7% paid by Attendi.

Our culture: People-oriented, curious, and proactive

title: Head of Content
description:
HEAD OF CONTENT

Bevado is hiring a Head of Content with a strong focus on video content creation.

Location: New York City, NY (onsite, five days a week).

This is a full-time, onsite role in New York City for someone who can turn software, product ideas and customer problems into videos people want to watch. You'll report directly to our Head of Growth and work closely with our founders to plan content, make it, publish it and improve it.

We care more about aptitude, creative judgment and the quality of your work than years on a resume. We’re looking for someone with 2-5 years of relevant experience.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own video production from idea to finished asset, including research, concepts, hooks, scripts, filming, editing, captions and publishing.

- Create short-form videos and ad creative for Meta and Instagram, plus short-form and long-form YouTube content.

- Help build our founders' presence on LinkedIn through video and written content that sounds like them and gives their audience something useful.

- Make product demos, launch videos and software explainers that communicate clear value to both SMB and enterprise buyers.

- Plan the content calendar with our Head of Growth, test original formats and improve creative using audience feedback and performance data.

- Contribute to product marketing and special projects, including landing page copy and design, lifecycle campaigns and broader brand initiatives. Use AI tools to speed up research, production and iteration.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- A strong video portfolio. You can make polished, engaging content and explain the creative choices behind it.

- You find yourself making videos, editing and experimenting with content in your own time. Personal accounts, side projects, internships and work for other companies all count.

- Good instincts for hooks, storytelling, pacing, sound, captions and visual presentation. You know how to make a video clear and hold someone's attention.

- The ability to take an idea and turn it into a finished video with ownership, initiative and consistent execution.

- Clear written and spoken English, curiosity about software and AI, and an interest in understanding the product and the people who use it.

- Comfort working closely with a small team, taking feedback and trying new approaches.

A STRONG BONUS

You've helped build an audience through content you produced for a personal brand, another company, an internship or a side project. Show us examples of work that earned attention, engagement or audience growth, and explain what you personally created. There is no minimum follower count.

SHOW US YOUR WORK

Send ben@bevado.com an email with any work that shows your content creation skills, whether that's a video, a social media profile, a portfolio link, or results from content you've created.

Include your strongest examples and a short explanation of what you personally handled, such as the concept, script, filming or editing.

BENEFITS

Annual base salary: $75,000-$130,000 USD.

- Free lunches five days a week

- Unlimited paid time off (PTO)

- Equity

- Health insurance

title: AI Deployment Manager - Australia
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re hiring the first AI Deployment Manager to partner with some of our most strategic enterprise customers. This role will be based in Sydney. As an AI Deployment Manager, you’ll drive adoption, deliver measurable business value, and help shape how AI transforms engineering teams. You’ll act as the connective tissue between customer stakeholders and our internal teams, influencing both the Grok roadmap and each customer’s implementation strategy.

This role is highly cross‑functional and customer‑facing. You understand software development workflows, care deeply about developer tools, and love helping engineering organizations succeed at scale.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Build and grow deep relationships with engineering leaders and power users at key accounts

- Partner with Field Engineering and Sales to deliver a seamless post‑sale experience

- Drive adoption of Grok by aligning usage with business objectives and engineering goals

- Guide customers on best practices for rollout, prompt strategy, context configuration, and internal enablement

- Serve as the customer’s voice internally and influence roadmap priorities

- Provide strategic account planning and regular business reviews with VP‑ and CTO‑level stakeholders

- Monitor account health, usage patterns, and product engagement to drive renewals and expansion

 

YOU MAY BE A FIT IF

- You have strong communication skills and executive presence, and are comfortable whiteboarding with developers and pivoting to value with a CTO

- You have a deep understanding of the software development lifecycle and engineering org structures

- You are fluent in technical workflows, AI tooling, and developer productivity (even if you haven’t been a full‑time engineer)

- You are customer‑obsessed with a knack for strategic thinking and problem‑solving

- You thrive in a startup environment: scrappy, proactive, and adaptable

- You have experience in TAM, Solutions Architecture, Customer Success, or Consulting for enterprise software

 

ABOUT

Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering.

Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truthseeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code.

 

APPLYING

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 2-3 short technicals. After, we'll schedule an onsite in our office, where you'll work on a small project, discuss ideas, and meet the team.

Clean K-Beauty Innovation. No compromises.

Yepoda is a clean K-Beauty brand that actually proves it works. We make Korean skincare without any of the compromises. Everything is clinically tested, 100% vegan, and formulated above EU standards. So you get the innovation and the results that K-Beauty is known for, plus a real commitment to sustainability. And we make it genuinely fun and easy to use - skincare you actually look forward to.

Founded in 2020 by Sander Joonyoung van Bladel and Veronika Strotmann, Yepoda is a certified B Corp™ and 1% for the Planet member, based in the heart of Berlin. Our products are available through our own online shop and, since March 2025, at Sephora Europe - online and in over 650 stores. With a team of 140+ brilliant individuals from around the world, we are actively shaping Yepoda's story every day.

As Senior Creative Strategist, you will sit at the intersection of performance marketing and our creative team, translating data into the stories, hooks, and formats that drive Yepoda's paid social growth. Your focus is to turn day-to-day performance metrics into actionable creative direction, keeping design, content, and influencer teams aligned on what's winning and why, while building the testing roadmaps that keep our creative pipeline ahead of platform trends.

- Deliver detailed, actionable creative briefs, direct-response copy, and frame-by-frame storyboards for the design team.

- Monitor day-to-day micro-metrics (thumb-stop ratios, 3-second hold rates, CTR) to rapidly diagnose asset performance and propose modular iterations.

- Act as the bridge between performance and creative by streamlining the asset request pipeline and managing the feedback loop between media buyers and designers.

- Supply the in-house production and influencer teams with data-backed insights, winning hooks, and performance trends to guide their shoots.

- Proactively design and build A/B testing roadmaps for new hooks, visual formats, and messaging angles.

- Present monthly reviews by synthesizing weekly learnings into macro-level creative presentations for stakeholders.

- Own post-click/CRO alignment by auditing and advising on e-commerce landing pages to ensure the post-click experience matches the ad narrative.

- Build secondary channel playbooks by adapting winning Meta/TikTok creatives for expansion channels like Pinterest, Snapchat, or Reddit.

YOUR PROFILE

- 4+ years of experience in a creative strategy or content strategy, ideally within a D2C or e-commerce brand and in touch with performance marketing.

- Proven experience optimizing paid social creative assets for Meta and/or TikTok, with a strong understanding of how platform algorithms use creative signals to define audience targeting.

- Comfortable working with performance data (thumb-stop ratios, hold rates, CTR) to diagnose what's working and translate it into new creative angles, not just report on it.

- Experience writing creative briefs, scripts, or storyboards for a design team; visual production skills (e.g. Canva) are a plus but not required.

- Strong cross-functional collaborator, comfortable aligning performance marketing, design, content, and influencer teams around a shared creative direction.

- Familiarity with workflow and creative analytics tools (e.g. Motion or similar).

- Fluent in English; Italian or French language is a plus.

- Dynamic Environment: The opportunity to work in a start-up environment surrounded by a passionate and dedicated team.
